# function: random_string

Returns `bytes` bytes, hex encoded, of SHA-256 over the environment name and `label`, the same value a `railway.go` file gets from `ctx.RandomString(label, bytes)`. It is derived, not secret: anyone who knows the environment name and label can compute it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_environment" "this" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "session_label" {
  value = provider::railway::random_string(data.railway_environment.this.name, "session", 16)
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
random_string(environment string, label string, bytes number) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `environment` (String) Environment name, such as `data.railway_environment.this.name`.
1. `label` (String) What the value is for. An empty label means `random`.
1. `bytes` (Number) Length in bytes, 1 to 32. Zero or less means 12.
